patch_description: This redesign uses a staged placement pipeline. First, it finds a feasible low-pressure assignment through binary search over the transformed KVPR capacity constraint. Then, instead of returning the greedy bin-packing result directly, it runs a separate local rebalancing phase that evaluates memory-safe model moves and swaps and keeps changes that reduce the lexicographic vector of GPU pressures. This separates feasibility construction from objective refinement, improving placement quality while keeping the implementation modular and reliable.
